Hymn 230: Scatter Sunshine
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Edwin O. Excell
Lyricist/Text Author: Lanta Wilson Smith
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 230 titled "Scatter Sunshine" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Edwin O. Excell and the lyrics were written by Lanta Wilson Smith.
